A MICRO STRATEGIES COMPANY



    IP Digital’s unique combination as a service integrator and innovative IP developer provides customers
    with a unique edge in implementing values from the start. IPDigital develops innovative intellectual

    Micro Strategies has distinguished itself as one of the most innovative technology solution providers and a

    client-first service and customer satisfaction.

    With a strong roster of satisfied clients across multiple industries, Micro Strategies is best known for its
    unique IT solutions built for the 21st Century. Micro Strategies is a Platinum partner with IBM, Microsoft,
    CISCO, CITRIX, HPE etc.,

    Website details: <u>https://www.ipdigitalllc.com/</u>; <u>https://microstrat.com/</u>;

    Job Description

    Role: Technical Specialist

    •     As a responsible Technical Specialist, you need to provide a high level of customer service to our clients
          across a wide variety of incidents and service requests.
    •     Provide both service  transition functions       and ongoing support            activities, as well as assist in the
          development of support processes and procedures where required.
    •     Provide support activities including Provisioning, Incident and Change Management across a wide
          range of technologies.
    •     Provide an effective and efficient end-user service as a central point of contact between end users and
          the Information Services for the reporting and resolution of incidents and service requests.
    •     Co-ordination and Interaction with business users via different modes of communication.


              IPJigital
      A MICRO STRATEGIES COMPANY

Required Skills

•     Strong understanding and experience supporting Windows 7 / Above and other Operating Systems
•     Strong Infrastructure knowledge like disc utilization, server monitoring, server housekeeping, patching,
      storage, VMware, Hyper and Azure.
•     Strong understanding and experience supporting Windows Server 2008, 2012, 2016
•     Strong understanding and experience supporting Office 365       Strong understanding and experience
      supporting Office 2007-2016
•     Strong understanding of Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy and User Permissions
•     Basic understanding of network concepts and ability to perform basic network troubleshooting. Installation
      and configuration of PC peripherals
•     Strong Analytical & problem-solving skills
•     Strong and fluent communication skills in English (verbal and written)
•     Ability to take direction or/and work independently in a fast-paced environment
•     Strong time management and ability to manage shifting priorities
•     Work in a fast-paced environment and be able to multitask


Desirable Skills

•     Experience with two factor authentication such as Duo or Okta
•     Knowledge of any CRM applications or any Software as a Service (SaaS) application Working Knowledge
      in any Ticketing Tool
•     Hands-on experience on Microsoft Exchange 2007/2016 Understanding of SCCM
•     Understanding of Android and iPhone configuration
•     Able to prepare end-user and/or technical documentation MCSE / MCSA / CCNA / CCNP Certifications
